hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_./-])(/[^ ]*/)?git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]+[^-[:space:]][^[:space:]]*)?)*[[:space:]]+commit([^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)' && [ "$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = main ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"On main: this repo is PR-only. Branch first (git checkout -b <topic>) in its own command, then commit."}}' || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); py="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.venv/bin/python"; case "$f" in *.py) [ -x "$py" ] || { echo "ruff hook: no venv at $py — skipped" 1>&2; exit 0; }; "$py" -m ruff check -q "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; true
